headline: US Authorizes 400,000-Barrel Crude Release From Strategic Reserve for Refinery
summary: The US Department of Energy approved an emergency exchange of up to 400,000 barrels from the Strategic Petroleum Reserve to supply Phillips 66's Lake Charles refinery following disruptions, as crude traded above $117.
why: The Strategic Petroleum Reserve provides emergency crude during domestic disruptions; its overall volumes are closely monitored by commodity desks.

impacts.name: Phillips 66
impacts.why: Access to emergency crude prevents processing downtime at the Lake Charles refinery facility.
